quest.title: Jnagarbha Day
quest.description: The Akademiya's Jnagarbha Day has finally come. All your plans and preparations are for one purpose, and one purpose only — to save a god.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x1200, Primogem x30, Mora x47625, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

chapter.title: Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises

talks.objective: Go to the Akademiya to meet up with Alhaitham

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Hello, you two. Sleep well?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, not really... Paimon got too nervous thinking about today and didn't fall asleep until the sun was almost up...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What about you, Alhaitham?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Naturally, I slept just fine. After all, a good rest should be considered part of the plan, since energy is an important resource.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y—You just wanna show off how calm you are!

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: It's crucial to dissipate any tension before we execute our plan.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The only thing you're doing is being annoying!

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Anyway, do you need me to go over the game plan again?

choices.text: Yes, just in case.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Our target is Grand Sage Azar's office. Everyone in the Akademiya knows that's where the Grand Sage's console is. Only they can operate it.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Many restricted commands and operations are executed via that console. I'm sure that console has a way to free Lesser Lord Kusanali.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You know, Paimon's been thinking... What kind of technology could let the sages imprison even a god?

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: That isn't something they could've accomplished with their scholarly talents alone. In the Sanctuary of Surasthana, there's a device of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's that she once used to isolate herself while meditating.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Five hundred years ago, the Grand Sage at the time modified the device so that it can no longer be controlled from the inside. They're effectively trapping one god with the power of another.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, uh, how are we gonna get to the Grand Sage's office?

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Don't forget, today is Jnagarbha Day, arguably the most important day to the Akademiya.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: The sages and core Akademiya personnel are busy loading the latest batch of research developments and legal decrees into Knowledge Capsules, so that they can be entered into the Akasha.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: All the Darshans' researchers have their noses to the grindstone, and the Akademiya's grounds are flowing with all sorts of people. It's the perfect time for an infiltration.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: When the Grand Sage leaves his office to supervise the entering process, that's our cue to access the console and free the Dendro Archon.

choices.text: When you put things that way...

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Well, yes. That's just the visible side of our plan, after all.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: If precedence holds, the Akademiya should have already started preparing for Jnagarbha Day.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Everyone should be in position. All that's left is for us to lead the charge!

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Let's go.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh... So are we just going to walk in through the front door? Or...?

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: ...Yes? Were you expecting a stealthier approach?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, Paimon can't think of a good comeback... Alright, it's all on Alhaitham if things go south.

choices.text: The plan feels a bit unrefined.
I want to confirm everything again.

talks.objective: Enter the Akademiya together with Alhaitham

dialogues.speaker: Viraf
dialogues.text: ...S—Scribe?

dialogues.speaker: Viraf
dialogues.text: Please wait. Are you Scribe Alhaitham?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Calm down, Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: That's me. Is something the matter? I'm in a hurry.

dialogues.speaker: Viraf
dialogues.text: Ah, n—no, I was just surprised to see you here. I had heard that the sages were looking for you not long ago, but I didn't know what for.

dialogues.speaker: Viraf
dialogues.text: And, um, also... Please don't bring outside guests into the Akademiya.

choices.text: (This isn't looking good...)

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Outside guests? How did you arrive at such a conclusion? Your groundless inference shames the Haravatat Darshan.

response.speaker: Viraf
response.text: Wh—What did you say...? I'm the top student in Haravatat, and I earned third place at the last inter-Darshan debate. Don't look down on me!

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: That wasn't my intention. As your Haravatat senior, I just assumed that you possessed a greater aptitude for critical thinking.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Look. Based on what you already know, the purpose of my return and the reason they're here should be obvious.

response.speaker: Viraf
response.text: I—Is that so... Wait a moment — let me think. Don't tell me the answer!

response.speaker: Viraf
response.text: #The sages' search for you... A {F#blonde}{M#blond}-haired traveler... Outside guests...

response.speaker: Viraf
response.text: So, from the start... the sages weren't looking for you, but this traveler? And you were gone from the Akademiya for so long because...

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Hey, shh... Yes, you've proven yourself as the top student in Haravatat. I surmise you have arrived at the correct conclusion.

response.speaker: Viraf
response.text: As I expected! Please forgive me, I wasn't thinking clearly just now. Thank you for getting me back on track.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: It's nothing. We'll be on our way, then.

response.speaker: Viraf
response.text: Alright. Thank you for your contributions to the Akademiya, Scribe.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What the heck just happened now...? What did he just guess?

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: I'm afraid I don't know either.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You have no idea!?

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Mhm. He convinced himself of whatever truth he came up with.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: That is the so-called "pride" of a scholar. If someone questions their academic facility, they will instantly feign understanding to keep up appearances.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Nowadays, the Akademiya is rampant with this type of scholar. Their obvious farces of intellect only serve to highlight themselves as fools.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, so there are special ways to deal with smart people. We don't even need to make up our own excuses...

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: We shouldn't waste any more time. It would be problematic if we missed our window of opportunity. Let's go.

choices.text: (We were noticed...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this the Akademiya's library?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Indeed. Known as the House of Daena, it is quite possibly the most extensive special collections library in Teyvat.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, there are a lot of students going through here... Is it really okay just to waltz right in?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: The Akademiya marches to a fast beat, especially since it's Jnagarbha Day. They're all occupied with their own matters.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Just act natural. Now, hurry along.

talks.objective: Hide for now and wait for an opportunity

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's this platform for?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: It's a lift that Akademiya personnel use to access higher floors.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are we gonna take it, then? The Grand Sage's office is up there somewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: No, not right now. We can't guarantee that we won't run into the Grand Sage. Let's step back and observe for now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You think the Grand Sage will exit from there?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And after he does, we'd sneak past him...? Paimon thinks that's really dangerous...

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Who knows. However, if we can confirm Azar's current location, our operation will be much safer if we...

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: ...Allow me to offer you a hint. If you wish to know his location, look behind you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aah, y—you're... What's Grand Sage Azar doing here!?

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Hmph...

response.speaker: Azar
response.text: Do not tell me you believed the Akademiya would not grow suspicious of you after such a prolonged absence... Scribe.

response.speaker: Azar
response.text: An eyewitness had informed me of your whereabouts, so I came to personally welcome you.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Grand Sage, I didn't expect you to care so much about me. I'm truly flattered.

response.speaker: Azar
response.text: I'm sure, but compared to you, I am far more interested in these two unexpected guests. You are... the Traveler and Paimon, correct?

response.speaker: Azar
response.text: It's a pity that only now have I been afforded the opportunity to formally meet two of Sumeru's most esteemed guests. I do apologize for my lack of decorum.

choices.text: Let's talk.

response.speaker: Azar
response.text: Excellent, you immediately initiated discussion instead of attempting to prepare some perfunctory excuse. You clearly understand the situation at hand and have no intention of making a reckless stand.

response.speaker: Azar
response.text: The foot traffic here renders this place unsuitable for discussion. Please, follow me to my office.

choices.text: It's not too late for you to stop.
Busted...

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: Always remember that your safety comes first. Don't forget that you're the star of Zubayr Theater.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aargh, don't lock us up! Let us out!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Waaah!

choices.text: ...That's enough, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh yeah, hehe... Paimon got a bit carried away there. How was Paimon's acting just now? Great, huh?

choices.text: Marvelous.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, everything's going according to plan so far! We made it into confinement, and Alhaitham's probably done with his part, too.

choices.text: That was close.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We even managed to trick Grand Sage Azar. Alhaitham sure knows how to cook up a plan.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What are we doing next? Paimon has trouble remembering things when she's worked up...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's review what we discussed during our strategy meeting.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right right~! Paimon thinks it went something like this...

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: #...Apart from that, we still have yet another goal in the first stage of our operation, which is to send {NICKNAME} to the confinement room.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #What!? Why do we want to get {NICKNAME} locked up on purpose?

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: #{NICKNAME}'s always been the person the sages are most afraid of, as well as the greatest obstacle to the successful implementation of their plan. They are very aware of the risk {F#she}{M#he} poses to them.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: #Once {NICKNAME} is imprisoned, the sages will likely think that everything is under control...

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: And with their guard down, the next phase of our plan will have a much higher chance of success.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Hmph, I can already see the pompous looks on their faces.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, that's a super tricky plan. But, Paimon still thinks it's not really worth it...

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: #That isn't the only reason, of course. {NICKNAME} has a more important task once {M#he}{F#she}'s in confinement.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: According to the Akademiya scholars in Rahman's custody, Lesser Lord Kusanali has sealed off her consciousness in the Akasha ever since she was captured by The Doctor.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: That way, they can't pry any more information from her.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Even if we break into the Sanctuary of Surasthana, it will take time to awaken Lesser Lord Kusanali's consciousness — we need to do that in advance.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So our job is to wake up Nahida! Okay, totally worth getting thrown in jail for.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: The confinement room is inside the Akademiya, close to the Sanctuary of Surasthana. It's a completely enclosed space, and you won't be receiving any visitors.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: I'll work with Rahman's scholars to make some modifications to your Akasha Terminal. Once you're in, get as close as you can to Lesser Lord Kusanali and try to connect to her consciousness.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: However, as for whether she'll actually wake up... That will depend on our luck.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh~ No wonder you've been wearing your Akasha Terminal today. It's the one that Alhaitham modified.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thought they'd take our Akasha Terminals when they locked us up in here. Hmm, were they being careless?

choices.text: That wasn't because of carelessness, but of their arrogance.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, so what now?

choices.text: We first need to find the place with the best signal in this room.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds easy enough. We can finally talk with Nahida after all this time... Let's do it!

choices.text: Then we try to connect with Nahida.
They think the Akasha is completely under their control.
We can relax for the time being.
Not bad, but worse than mine.
I don't think the guards can hear us anymore.

talks.objective: Find a way to connect to Nahida's consciousness

dialogues.speaker: Phaki
dialogues.text: ...You think we'll get yelled at again if we play here?

dialogues.speaker: Habi
dialogues.text: Psh, there's nothing to be scared about. If we can shake Mr. Zubayr, the people at the Akademiya will be a piece of cake.

dialogues.speaker: Phaki
dialogues.text: But that grandpa with the blue hat and long beard looks really scary... You think he'll be here today?

dialogues.speaker: Mir
dialogues.text: ...I thought you'd be interested in the Jnagarbha Day ceremony, but you're just out here instead.

dialogues.speaker: Azmi
dialogues.text: Resting when everyone else is busy makes this moment even more idyllic. *sigh* You still have so much to learn when it comes to romance!

dialogues.speaker: Mir
dialogues.text: Uh... Okay, as long as you're happy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh, is this the right spot? Are you getting anything?

choices.text: It's faint, but...I have a signal.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aah, please work!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Is this... a realm of consciousness?)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Nahida's not moving. She really has sealed off her consciousness... I need to think of a way to wake her up.)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (What is this...? It looks like... some sort of barrier?)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Is Nahida using this barrier to isolate her consciousness from the outside world?)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Nahida!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Hey, Nahida!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Dang it, she isn't reacting. Seems like she can't sense me...)

response.speaker: Nahida
response.text: ...When did it first start?

response.speaker: Nahida
response.text: ...Oh, right. It started from the moment I was born.

response.speaker: Nahida
response.text: I want to become a worthy archon.

choices.text: Preparing to connect with her consciousness now.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: Nilou, are you sure about this? You're taking such a great risk for them...

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: I'm sure, and I'm going. You know that I don't like to pass up any opportunity to dance, and this one is especially important.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: *sigh* Alright. You seem to have a lot of trust in them, so I won't say more on the subject.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: But if anything happens, the few of us here may not be able to help you.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Don't worry, they've been through worse. Everything's going to be fine!

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: Alright. You know... if you really do get arrested, we'll do everything we can to get you back. Be careful, even if it's only for our sakes.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Hehe, thanks, Mr. Zubayr. You're so very kind.

dialogues.speaker: Hushang
dialogues.text: Nilou! How's it going? Nervous?

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Definitely more than usual, but it's because I'm worried I won't dance well enough.

dialogues.speaker: Farhad
dialogues.text: It's okay, just focus on your performance. We'll take care of everything else.

dialogues.speaker: Hushang
dialogues.text: Heh, you sure know how to talk. Taking all the credit, even though we came here together to help out.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Well, thank you both! I'll have to treat you to a meal after all this ends. I really, really appreciate all of your help.

dialogues.speaker: Hushang
dialogues.text: Ooh, that sounds great! How can we say no to that?

dialogues.speaker: Farhad
dialogues.text: Alright, let's get back to business. Nilou, we'll be here to keep people from going to the Akademiya, so they don't interrupt your performance.

dialogues.speaker: Hushang
dialogues.text: I was planning on telling them something like, "The Akademiya's been conducting a weird experiment, and some of their test subjects escaped. It's really dangerous there, so stay away!"

dialogues.speaker: Farhad
dialogues.text: Ugh, you couldn't think of anything better? *sigh* Oh well, I guess it does sound like something the Akademiya would do.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Hehe, I think it sounds great. I'm counting on you guys!

dialogues.speaker: Hushang
dialogues.text: Don't worry, it'll be a piece of cake!

dialogues.speaker: Vihar
dialogues.text: Hey, Nilou. Sorry, it's great to see you, but I'm really busy right now. Our "Bait People Away with Yalda Candies" plan is working beautifully.

dialogues.speaker: Vihar
dialogues.text: Do you want some candy? We have more than we can give out.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Vihar, thank you so much for doing all of this, and even dressed up as the Knight of Flowers, no less.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: I'll pass on the candy, though. I cut back on sweets in the period leading up to a performance, and I'm about to start one!

dialogues.speaker: Vihar
dialogues.text: Haha, you have a point. The "stage" is cleared and everything's ready, so you can start your performance at any time.

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Yeah, thanks to you. I'm really grateful. Alright, time to hit the "stage"!

dialogues.speaker: Vihar
dialogues.text: You're welcome. The honor's all mine, since I'll have such a great view of the show.

dialogues.speaker: Observe the unconscious guards...
dialogues.text: (Someone has knocked these two guards out and removed their Akasha Terminals not long ago. No one seems to have noticed them yet.)

dialogues.speaker: Observe the unconscious guards...
dialogues.text: (If they were escorting someone before being knocked out, that person must've escaped.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Ehhh, did you hear that, {NICKNAME}? It sounds like a lot of guards just ran by.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Does this mean the plan has moved onto the next stage?

choices.text: Certainly sounds like it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep yep! It's great that everything seems to be going well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come to think of it, when did Alhaitham replace the Knowledge Capsule that was about to be entered into the Akasha?

choices.text: When he pretended that he had been corrupted...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, so that's when he did it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon was too nervous to notice.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of, didn't Alhaitham also yoink the Divine Knowledge Capsule from that mercenary leader in Port Ormos when everyone else was distracted?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's a time-tested trick of his...

choices.text: He can maintain his composure when things get chaotic.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph. Why are we complimenting him? Yeah, he's smart and all, but he still makes Paimon's blood boil!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's review our plan for this stage again! It's not like we have anything else to do right now anyway, and it'll help us feel more confident.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon remembers that Nilou's task was supposed to go a bit like this...

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: ...Now that Lesser Lord Kusanali's consciousness has been forcefully sealed, the core figures of the Akademiya and their guards have started to wear their Akasha Terminals again.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: With The Doctor's technological support, they think they have nothing to fear.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: How despicable of them to rely on such a person.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: But, this is also our chance.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: I was originally asked to draft the Knowledge Capsule for the "Artistic Performances Prohibition Act" when I was still at the Akademiya.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: It should be on the Grand Sage's desk right now, and will be entered into the Akasha during the next Jnagarbha Day.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are they really going to stop all artistic performances? That's horrible...

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: I'll make an identical Knowledge Capsule, but this time, I'll "smuggle" some misleading information into it.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: We only need to find an opportunity to switch the capsules. Once it's been entered into the Akasha on Jnagarbha Day, if someone were to be seen performing in public...

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: The sages would definitely use that opportunity to announce the ban, and so the misleading information will be disseminated amongst the guards.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Sure sounds complicated, but it seems like if everything goes well, we'll be able to get rid of all the guards in the Akademiya without any effort...

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: That's pretty clever. Gettin' right into their heads.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: I just have one question. Even if we manage to get the misleading info out to the guards, how can we be sure that they'll believe it?

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: People who are used to relying on the Akasha become less inquisitive, and their ability to distinguish truth from misinformation is significantly reduced... They will view everything the Akasha releases to them as the unequivocal truth.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: The Akasha will turn humans into "machines." I've seen it happen many times.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Yikes... Good thing I didn't wear it for long when I was working in Sumeru City. At first, I thought it was a good thing, too.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: By the way, this plan still requires a performer, right?

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Do you have someone in mind?

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Nilou of Zubayr Theater. I know her really well. We can trust her.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: I'm kinda hesitant to ask her to participate in a dangerous plan like this, but we can ask her in person.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Alright. After the guards in the Akademiya are gone...

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Then it'll be time for me and my stowaway brothers to shine.

choices.text: That's why he can pull off this kind of thing...
Do you remember when he rushed towards the Grand Sage?
It sounds like Nilou completed her task.

talks.objective: Interlude: Conversation Between Dehya and Rahman
Interlude: Conversation Between Dehya and Rahman

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Here they come. Did you see that, Rahman? They came out from the Akademiya in droves!

dialogues.speaker: Rahman
dialogues.text: *whistle*

dialogues.speaker: Rahman
dialogues.text: After laying low in the city for so long, this is the moment we've been waiting for. My brothers have already sprung into action.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Heh, we couldn't do anything to 'em inside their coop, but outside the Akademiya... This is our hunting ground.

dialogues.speaker: Rahman
dialogues.text: With a lioness like you, the prey sure won't be able to run far, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: We still need to eliminate the guards as soon as possible. If we give the sages enough time to realize what's happening, the plan's doomed.

dialogues.speaker: Rahman
dialogues.text: Eh, all they've done is to sit on their cushy salaries and twiddle their thumbs all day while we fought and struggled every day in the desert. The only advantage they might have is their numbers.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, most of the guards who report directly to the six sages belong to the Corps of Thirty, but they have a completely different reputation.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Following those blasted sages' every whim, throwing away all the principles of being a mercenary... As someone in the same profession, I'm obligated to teach them a good lesson today.

dialogues.speaker: Rahman
dialogues.text: Indeed. The "trap" has been set. All we need to do is lead them there.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Alright, let's each take a road and herd those scattered guards back into one place. Make sure to attract their attention. Isak will be the key.

dialogues.speaker: Rahman
dialogues.text: You gave such an important task to that child... Will he be okay?

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: It'll be fine. Isak was so determined to help, so let's put our faith in him.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Besides, even if he's caught, the guards would be too scared to do anything to him... They've never seen Lesser Lord Kusanali in person, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Rahman
dialogues.text: You've got a point. Anyway, I think I see them coming. Let's head out.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Good luck.

dialogues.speaker: Isak
dialogues.text: Hmm, this outfit...

dialogues.speaker: Tanina
dialogues.text: Hey, do you remember what you need to do, Isak? When the guards get here, you'll pretend to be Lesser Lord Kusanali and run away from them.

dialogues.speaker: Isak
dialogues.text: Oh yeah... I remember, of course I do. I'm just a little nervous...

dialogues.speaker: Tanina
dialogues.text: Relax. Don't think about getting caught. Even if that happens, we won't leave you behind.

dialogues.speaker: Tanina
dialogues.text: You only need to think about getting the guards' attention and leading them to the Grand Bazaar. Leave the rest to us.

dialogues.speaker: Isak
dialogues.text: Okay, got it. I'm here to pay back Lesser Lord Kusanali for helping Grandpa. I won't get cold feet!

dialogues.speaker: Maqrin
dialogues.text: Hey, they're here! I can see the Akademiya guards!

dialogues.speaker: Tanina
dialogues.text: All right! It's time, Isak. Take a deep breath... and go! You can do this!

dialogues.speaker: Isak
dialogues.text: (Why is there a guard over there? Did he already run ahead of me?)

dialogues.speaker: Isak
dialogues.text: (This is different from our plan, but there's no time. I need to make a choice...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hide in the field

dialogues.speaker: Player

dialogues.speaker: Akademiya Guard
dialogues.text: I'd better go have a look...

dialogues.text: Were my eyes playing tricks on me...?
*rustle*

dialogues.speaker: Akademiya Guard Captain
dialogues.text: ...Where did she go? How did she disappear? Did we lose her? Hurry up and find her!

dialogues.speaker: Akademiya Guard
dialogues.text: Hey... Why's your team here? Didn't we say to split up our search?

dialogues.speaker: Akademiya Guard
dialogues.text: Hurry, hurry! Eh? This place is... Why are you all here?

dialogues.speaker: Rahman
dialogues.text: Yeah, isn't it one heck of a coincidence? Everybody's here... What on earth is going on?

dialogues.speaker: Rahman
dialogues.text: I suppose that's all of you?

dialogues.speaker: Akademiya Guard Captain
dialogues.text: Who are you!? Did you set us up...? What are you planning?

dialogues.speaker: Isak
dialogues.text: *pant* Whew, that was rough. I almost got caught!

dialogues.speaker: Akademiya Guard Captain
dialogues.text: Little brat... So you're not actually Lesser Lord Kusanali? Who exactly are you all? Eremites from the desert?

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Just some colleagues. Think of this as a business competition or a personal grudge...

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: After stepping into our trap, stop thinking of yourselves as "hunters." Behave like the "prey" you are.

dialogues.speaker: Rahman
dialogues.text: *whistle*

dialogues.speaker: Akademiya Guard Captain
dialogues.text: An ambush! How's that possible? This is Sumeru City, but mercenaries from the desert somehow ambushed us!?

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Tsk, you've spent all your time hiding away in the Akademiya. This place has long since become our hunting ground. Brace yourselves!

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: Hmm... This is odd...

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: The Akademiya has quieted down after the conclusion of the Jnagarbha Day ceremonies, but it's much quieter than usual.

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: Where are the guards? Why have I not seen a single one...? Guards? Guards!

dialogues.speaker: Uday
dialogues.text: Grand Sage, how may I be of assistance?

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: I called for the guards. Why did you come?

dialogues.speaker: Uday
dialogues.text: Ah... M—My apologies, Grand Sage.

dialogues.speaker: Uday
dialogues.text: Right now, all Akademiya guards have entered the city to perform the ordered arrest. I thought you knew...

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: Arrest? Who is there to arrest...?

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: (I have an ominous feeling...)

dialogues.speaker: Uday
dialogues.text: A—Arrest Lesser Lord Kusanali, right? Is that not what the order was?

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: Lesser Lord Kusanali? You mean she has disappeared?

dialogues.speaker: Uday
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. I wouldn't dare make up something like that...

dialogues.speaker: Uday
dialogues.text: Right now, everyone is in a panic, and many are saying that... that Lesser Lord Kusanali will take revenge on us...

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: (What happened? Just what is going on?)

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: (Lesser Lord Kusanali somehow escaped? Was it Alhaitham and his party that freed her?)

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: (That's impossible... The Akademiya is heavily guarded today, and any order to release Lesser Lord Kusanali would be strictly confidential. Besides, Alhaitham and the Traveler are already in our hands...)

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: (What manner of trickery did they employ? How could Lesser Lord Kusanali disappear into thin air...?)

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: (Disappear... Wait...)

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: How was the arrest order distributed to the guards?

dialogues.speaker: Uday
dialogues.text: It was issued by the Akasha earlier today. Only you have the authority to send messages like that, so I thought it was your order...

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: ...Let me check.

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: ...Ah, here.

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: "Lesser Lord Kusanali has escaped from the Sanctuary of Surasthana. Go to the city and arrest the escapee immediately..."

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: (The Akasha indeed contains this information, and it clearly appeared in my mind.)

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: (...How did they bypass my permissions to issue this kind of message?)

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: (Was it the report about the Traveler that Alhaitham submitted?)

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: (No, I specifically checked that Knowledge Capsule before entering it into the Akasha... Could that have been... a red herring?)

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: (Well, even if I figure it out now, it won't make any difference. The important thing now is to confirm Lesser Lord Kusanali's status...)

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: Have you been to the Sanctuary of Surasthana to confirm that Lesser Lord Kusanali has indeed escaped?

dialogues.speaker: Uday
dialogues.text: Confirm? No, I—I haven't...

dialogues.speaker: Uday
dialogues.text: I—It may be a bit offensive to say this, but... Grand Sage, what you're saying doesn't make any sense...

dialogues.speaker: Uday
dialogues.text: How can the information in the Akasha be inaccurate...? What the Akasha decrees is fact — that is common knowledge to all of us...

dialogues.speaker: Uday
dialogues.text: If we have to confirm the information and knowledge from the Akasha ourselves...

dialogues.speaker: Uday
dialogues.text: Then how is that any different from us learning that information ourselves? Wouldn't Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's legacy lose its meaning that way...?

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: In the beginning, it was I who asked you to believe in the Akasha, to believe in the legacy left by Greater Lord Rukkhadevata... Are you trying to use my words against me?

dialogues.speaker: Uday
dialogues.text: N—No! Grand Sage, I'm merely confused because I believe in you. I never meant to refute you...

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: Hmph... Stay here and see if there are any suspicious people around... I'll go to the Sanctuary of Surasthana on my own.

dialogues.speaker: Uday
dialogues.text: Yes, Grand Sage...

talks.objective: Interlude: Grand Sage Azar Arriving at the Sanctuary of Surasthana
Interlude: Grand Sage Azar Arriving at the Sanctuary of Surasthana

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Grand Sage Azar arrives at the Sanctuary of Surasthana alone...

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: ("Lesser Lord Kusanali has escaped from the Sanctuary of Surasthana. Go to the city and arrest the escapee immediately...")

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: (How can that be...? Stop thinking about it, stop... It must be a trick of theirs. As long as I personally confirm it...)

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: Ah...

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: ...Impossible. That's impossible. There must be something wrong with my eyes...

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: Eh? She really appeared again... What is the meaning of this...?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: What a comical sight, Azar.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Once the Akasha has put certain thoughts into your head, even the Grand Sage can no longer see what's right in front of him.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: You all can only see the world in your mind, the one you think you know.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: And precisely because of this, you disregarded Lesser Lord Kusanali's existence...

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: She has been a wise and worthy archon.

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: Cyno... Have you been waiting for a chance like this?

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: The Akasha predicted that you would return to the Akademiya to confront me, but I didn't expect it to turn out like this. I was careless.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: No, you were blinded. Your faults stem from your reliance on the Akasha. You're still the same as always.

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: I truly did not expect a proud person like you to cooperate with Alhaitham and the Traveler...

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: People change, Azar. Admit it, the Akasha can't predict my actions anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: Hmph, then tell me, what have you found during your investigation?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: You want to buy time? This is the Sanctuary of Surasthana. Under your own regulations, even Akademiya staff are forbidden to come here... No one will come to save you.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: As for the investigation... I've at least confirmed that you are guilty of insurgency against the archon, a serious crime.

dialogues.speaker: Azar
dialogues.text: So what? Did you do all of this so I would plead guilty in front of you, General Mahamatra?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: No. I want you to plead guilty in front of the archon herself.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: You once said that I had no standing to judge you. So now, how about judgment in the name of a god?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... How long do we have to wait? Paimon wants to know how things are going out there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon hasn't heard any sounds outside for a while. Hopefully something bad didn't happen...

choices.text: Don't think like that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, but aren't you scared that we might be locked up in here for the rest of our lives?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Thinking about it, at least Paimon has you. We can still chat like this...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: When Paimon thinks of Nahida being imprisoned alone in the Sanctuary of Surasthana, Paimon can't help but feel sorry for her...

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Here comes your savior!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Dehya! Hehe, Paimon just knew you would come to rescue us!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You were scared out of your wits just a moment ago...

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: You two really owe me some big thanks. I had to search through who knows how many guards to find the key here... It felt even more tiring than whacking 'em! I'm exhausted.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Thanks a lot. Need Paimon to rub your shoulders?

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Uh... No, no, that's... Er, I'll pass.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What are you afraid of? Oh, are you ticklish?

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Ugh, now isn't the time to talk about being ticklish...

choices.text: How are things going outside?

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Things in the city and on Cyno's side are both going well. The guards that stormed out of the Akademiya are all taken care of.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: The Corps of Thirty is in charge of the city's defenses, but we already talked to Asfand. They've been fed up with the sages bossing them around.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: As long as it doesn't break their employment contracts, they'll turn a blind eye.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's probably because you've been super great friends with them for a long time. So, how's Cyno doing?

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: The Grand Sage is in his custody. Even I know how terrible it is to fall into Cyno's hands, so he probably does, too.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Cyno forced him to release Lesser Lord Kusanali. He has no choice but to obey.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: So, hurry to the Sanctuary of Surasthana. Assuming nothing weird happened...

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: ...We should've already rescued our archon.

choices.text: That all sounds amazing.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Honestly, I didn't expect our ragtag bunch to do this well. We just came together last minute to save the archon, you know?

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: All right, you two better go. I still have to clean up some messes in the city. See you around.

choices.text: We managed to rescue her!
How's Nahida?
We must trust our friends.

dialogues.speaker: Hushang
dialogues.text: You really like to play cool in front of Nilou.

dialogues.speaker: Farhad
dialogues.text: Hey, cut it out... This isn't the time to chat about stuff like that.

talks.objective: Go to the Sanctuary of Surasthana

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nahida...

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: Should I say "It's nice to meet you"?

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: This is the first time we've met in real life. Before, we've only met in dreams, consciousness, or when I was in someone else's body.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We finally meet, Nahida.

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: Thank you so much for coming to rescue me, but I also need to apologize...

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: During this time, I did some self-reflection. My sense of inferiority and yielding to the Akademiya led to all of this, and created so much trouble for you all.

choices.text: Don't worry about it. You've also helped us a lot.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly! We're here because you're a good archon and one of our friends.

response.speaker: Nahida
response.text: Hehe... Thanks, you two.

response.speaker: Nahida
response.text: Whew... Amazing, so this is how it feels to walk out of that cage with my own body.

response.speaker: Nahida
response.text: It's like I just had an endlessly long dream... I can't even tell if I just woke up or was only now born into this world.

response.speaker: Nahida
response.text: My concept of "self" has become so clear...

response.speaker: Nahida
response.text: But now doesn't seem to be the time to indulge in this feeling.

choices.text: The Akademiya's god creation plan...

response.speaker: Nahida
response.text: Um, this is really embarrassing. You all just rescued an archon, and now she needs your help to save her country, and even the entire world.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's okay. With you here, Paimon's sure that everything will work out!

response.speaker: Nahida
response.text: There's one more thing...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What is it?

response.speaker: Nahida
response.text: For all the things the Akademiya did to me, and for all the folly it committed in the name of wisdom... As their archon, I will make them pay!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow! That's the spirit! You're finally standing up for yourself and not letting people walk all over you!

response.speaker: Nahida
response.text: Hehe... I understand now: To be a better archon, I first need to better myself.

response.speaker: Nahida
response.text: If you haven't even figured out how to be a caterpillar, how can you be a butterfly?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: This is knowledge that only you yourself could have discovered.

response.speaker: Nahida
response.text: Yes, true. Hm, that reminds me, I wonder how far along the Akademiya is with their god creation plan...

response.speaker: Nahida
response.text: We need to hurry and prevent the birth of that false god.

response.speaker: Nahida
response.text: I need to make some preparations. Since I'm now free, I can establish a direct link to the Akasha and control it.

response.speaker: Nahida
response.text: First things first, I need to remove the restrictions that The Doctor put on me in the Akasha...

response.speaker: Nahida
response.text: After that, I'll make some adjustments and revoke the sages' permissions. The Akasha will then be like how it originally was: only operable by the archon.

response.speaker: Nahida
response.text: ...After all, the Akademiya betrayed Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's trust.

response.speaker: Nahida
response.text: This might take some time. In the meantime, you should also work on your own preparations.

response.speaker: Nahida
response.text: If we don't stop the god creation plan in time, we'll be in for a tough fight.

choices.text: Saving Irminsul...
You deserved to be freed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's a light flashing on your Akasha Terminal. It's almost like... the faster it blinks, the better the signal.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, it's Mora! Ooh, Mora... No Paimon, we're not here to hunt for treasure!

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: This isn't the way to the Akademiya. Better stick to the plan.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #We might as well prepare for a fight, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: When we're done, we can take a walk around. After all, we missed out on a lot of stuff when we were locked up.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: ...Oh, right. It started from the moment I was born.\n

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: I want to become a worthy archon.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: So I've kept studying...\n

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Kept listening to my people and their hearts...\n

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Kept looking for a way to save Irminsul...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: So I can catch up...\n

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Catch up to Greater Lord Rukkhadevata.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: But, I'm stuck in the Sanctuary of Surasthana...\n

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The sages are creating a god to replace me...\n

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: And I'm forced to lock my consciousness in this boundless darkness.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: It's... so quiet here.\n

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Now that I think of it, I don't think I've ever actually listened to my own inner voice...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Do archons have them?\n

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Should archons have them?\n

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Have I been... doing the right thing?\n

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Am I... really not needed?\n

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: How do I... really feel about all of this?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: It's... so quiet here.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Since you're the God of Wisdom...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You've known the answers to all these questions since the very beginning, haven't you?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Who... are you? Whose voice is that? It sounds familiar...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: ...You're right, though.\n

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: I won't... I won't ignore my own voice anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text:
Story Review:

You and Alhaitham go to the Grand Sage Azar's office to look for a way to free Nahida.
However, the Grand Sage, who is well-prepared, sends you into confinement and exiles Alhaitham. But everything seems to be going according to plan...

Meanwhile, Nilou dances outside of the Akademiya, which then triggers the faked order Alhaitham has implanted into the Akasha, causing all the guards in the Akademiya to rush into the city.
Dehya and the desert folk, who have been waiting in ambush for them, catch all of them once they are inside the trap.

Story Review:

You and Alhaitham go to the Grand Sage Azar's office to look for a way to free Nahida.
However, the Grand Sage, who is well-prepared, sends you into confinement and exiles Alhaitham. But everything seems to go as planned...
In the confinement room, you manage to awaken Nahida's sealed consciousness using the modified Akasha Terminal.
Meanwhile, Nilou dances outside of the Akademiya, which then triggers the faked order Alhaitham has implanted into the Akasha, causing all the guards in the Akademiya to rush into the city.

dialogues.speaker: Vihar
dialogues.text: Hey, it's you guys! How did your plan go? Are you here for Nilou?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It went really well! And yeah, where's Nilou?

dialogues.speaker: Vihar
dialogues.text: Great to hear! Nilou's already returned to the Grand Bazaar. Just now, a crowd of Akademiya students came by to ask Nilou for her signature. I've never seen her run away so fast!

dialogues.speaker: Vihar
dialogues.text: To think the Akademiya wants to ban artistic performances... Hehe, I think their students would be the first to disagree.
